reply_text:
I found one candidate from 2021 that meets all four tests.

- **The candidate:** on Tesla's Q4 2020 earnings call on 27 January 2021, Musk said he was "highly confident the car will drive itself for the reliability in excess of a human this year." It's a self-driving forecast, which I counted as a forecast about what AI will do. If your rules treat self-driving as a product claim instead, drop it and the year has nothing to report. I read it in the Motley Fool's transcript of the call, not in a recording.
- **Lex Fridman podcast #252 (28 December 2021):** search snippets show Musk saying of full self-driving, "it's looking quite likely that it will be next year." I couldn't verify it, so it isn't listed. Both transcript pages I opened cut off around the 33-minute mark, before that exchange at 1:34:32, and the forum thread quoting it wouldn't open. That was my last page opening. Opening a full transcript would settle it.
- **Tesla Bot prototype "next year" (AI Day, 19 August 2021):** this is the claim you already have on file. I only saw it in search snippets and never opened a page with Musk's words, so I haven't listed it.
- **Q2 2021 earnings call (July):** Musk said he was "confident" the cars "will be able to drive themselves," with no date attached. It isn't about AGI, so it doesn't belong under undated either.
- **The three fixed searches:** they returned almost nothing from 2021, mostly recent coverage of later predictions. I used 10 of the 12 searches and all 6 page openings. I didn't spend the last two searches because I couldn't have opened anything they found.
